cohort: 9 patients who underwent surgery for abdominal wall endometriosis
finding: In patients with periodic abdominal pain and swelling on the abdominal wall, abdominal wall endometriosis should be suspected, especially in those with a history of cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study investigated abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE) and found that all but one patient had a history of cesarean section.
